entities.name: UE in RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control connected state where UE can perform measurements with network configuration.

entities.name: UE in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle or inactive states where UE performs measurements based on idle carrier configuration.

entities.name: Measurement Object
entities.description: Configuration parameters for NR measurements including beam averaging and consolidation thresholds.

entities.name: Report Configuration
entities.description: Configuration parameters specifying measurement quantities and reference signal types (SS/PBCH or CSI-RS).

entities.name: measIdleCarrierListNR
entities.description: Configuration for idle/inactive state measurements within VarMeasIdleConfig.

entities.name: Cell measurement derivation based on SS/PBCH block
entities.description: Procedure to derive RSRP, RSRQ, and SINR measurements from SS/PBCH blocks using beam consolidation and averaging.

entities.name: Cell measurement derivation based on CSI-RS
entities.description: Procedure to derive cell measurements from applicable CSI-RS resources using beam consolidation and averaging.

entities.name: No averaging configuration condition
entities.description: Condition when nrofSS-BlocksToAverage or nrofCSI-RS-ResourcesToAverage is not configured.

entities.name: No consolidation threshold condition
entities.description: Condition when absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation or absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation is not configured.

entities.name: Beam measurement below threshold condition
entities.description: Condition when the highest beam measurement quantity value is below or equal to the consolidation threshold.

entities.name: Use highest beam measurement value
entities.description: Property where cell measurement quantity is derived as the highest beam measurement quantity value.

entities.name: Average beams above threshold
entities.description: Property where cell measurement quantity is derived as linear power scale average of beams above consolidation threshold.

entities.name: Apply layer 3 cell filtering
entities.description: Property where layer 3 filtering is applied to cell measurements as described in clause 5.5.3.2.

relations.description: SS/PBCH based cell measurement derivation requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
SS/PBCH based cell measurement derivation requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE state.
SS/PBCH based derivation uses parameters from Measurement Object configuration.
SS/PBCH derivation procedure is guarded by absence of averaging configuration.
SS/PBCH derivation procedure is guarded by absence of consolidation threshold.
SS/PBCH derivation procedure is guarded by beam measurement below threshold condition.
Absence of averaging configuration establishes use of highest beam measurement value.
Absence of consolidation threshold establishes use of highest beam measurement value.
Beam measurement below threshold establishes use of highest beam measurement value.
SS/PBCH derivation includes step to average beams above consolidation threshold.
SS/PBCH derivation includes step to apply layer 3 cell filtering.
CSI-RS based cell measurement derivation requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
CSI-RS based derivation uses parameters from Measurement Object configuration.
CSI-RS derivation includes step to apply layer 3 cell filtering.
